table_name: Table 4 - Travel Distance (Based on Occupancy and Construction Type)
note_2026_revision: Table 4 travel distance values were updated in the 2026 revision (per the NBCS 2026 Foreword, item (f)). Do NOT port 2016 travel distance assumptions into 2026 calculations.

rows.note: N.A. for unsprinklered/Type 3-4 - datacentres must be sprinklered.
Type 3/4 construction not permitted for this occupancy (see note 3).
Type 3/4 construction not permitted for this occupancy (see note 3).

notes: 1. The common path of travel should be not more than 50 percent of the travel distance values above.
2. Ramps are not counted as an exit in case of basements below the first basement in car parking.
3. Construction of Type 3 or Type 4 is not permitted for Industrial (G) or the occupancies where type3_4 is null in this table.
4. Utility service areas and equipment areas may be exempt from travel distance measurement from within the room.

5. For ceiling height >= 10 m at ground floor (airports, exhibition halls, convention centres, mall atria, entrance lobbies, etc.) with sprinkler system, travel distance may be increased by 100 percent of the values specified - not applicable to the sprinklered-Type-1/2 column.

6. For such buildings with ceiling height >= 17 m and sprinkler-exempt, travel distance may similarly be increased by 100 percent - not applicable to the sprinklered-Type-1/2 column. Suitable smoke/heat venting is recommended in such cases to prevent heat build-up at ceiling level.
